sources: https://dec.ny.gov/places/sugar-hill-state-forest (read via WebFetch; dec.ny.gov refuses plain curl)

values.note: No reservation system: 'if you arrive and it is full you will have to find another location to camp.' Campers fill out a self-issued camping permit at the restroom on arrival. On state forest land, camping more than three nights or in groups of ten or more needs a permit from a Forest Ranger.

booking.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/sugar-hill-state-forest ('Campsites are available on a first-come first-serve basis, with 22 designated campsites available. There is no reservation system...'; 'Upon arrival, campers must fill out a self-issued camping permit available at the restroom'; 'Camping for more than three nights or in groups of ten or more requires a permit from a Forest Ranger'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/sugar-hill-state-forest ('No camper hookups to water spigot or electrical outlets'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 22 designated campsites in a nine-acre open field (the accessibility section says 26). DEC states no rig length.

sites.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/sugar-hill-state-forest ('22 designated campsites available'; 'one of the 26 campsites in a nine-acre open field for camping with restrooms'), read 2026-10-21. max_rig_ft 31 was note-derived and DEC states no length, so it is cleared.

values.note: The gate opens to vehicles and the water is turned on from the 3rd Monday in May through the 3rd Monday in October (2026: gates opened Monday, May 18).

season.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/sugar-hill-state-forest ('The gate is opened to vehicle traffic, and the water turned on, from the 3rd Monday in May through the 3rd Monday in October of each year'; 'when the gates open Monday, May 18, 2026'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Normally a restroom with potable water in summer, but DEC's alert says restrooms and potable water are unavailable 'for an indeterminate timeframe' until the water system is repaired; ADA portable restrooms instead (2026 season).

facilities.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/sugar-hill-state-forest (alert: 'Restrooms and potable water service are unavailable for an indeterminate timeframe until repairs to the water system infrastructure are complete'; 'Americans with Disabilities Act accessible portable restrooms will be available on opening day'; 'during summer months a restroom with potable water is available'), read 2026-10-21

note: DEC Sugar Hill State Forest camping area by the fire tower: a nine-acre open field. The trailhead has horse stalls and a mounting platform, but the area is general camping, not a horse camp (no horses in the camping area's side hill or picnic area). --Claude
summary: DEC's page confirms 22 first-come designated sites (26 in its accessibility section) in a nine-acre open field, self-issued permit, no reservations, no hookups; it is a general camping area with horse facilities at the trailhead, not a horse camp. Added season (3rd Monday May-3rd Monday Oct gate) and a facilities note on the current restroom/water outage. Cleared the note-derived max_rig_ft 31 (DEC states no length; an open field, drive-in through the seasonal gate). Fees left free (note-derived; page not quoted on fees). Note trimmed of booking/fee/hookup/site text and the unsupported 28-31 ft claim.
